summary: Phase 9 (brand colour + private share links) tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest file with 13 tests, all passing. Phase 6/7/8 regression: 72 tests, all passing. Frontend: tested on desktop 1920 and mobile 390. Working: the colour picker, the invalid-code error, the too-light warning, the portal accent switch and reset back to teal, all three share dialogs, Open, the Shared links list, Switch off, the 410 page for a switched-off link and the receipt download as a file. One real bug: every share dialog creates 2 links per click.

minor.issue: No rate limit or abuse protection. Tokens are 24 bytes from token_urlsafe, so brute force is not realistic. Already deferred by E1.

ui_bugs.issue: Each 'Get link' / 'Quote link' / payment 'Link' click creates TWO share_links docs, about 3-300 ms apart. Seen in the DB for E1's own 23:56 pair and for every UI click in this run. Cause: the POST /agent/share-links call sits inside useEffect([body, qc]), and React.StrictMode (index.js) runs effects twice in dev. The Shared links card then shows duplicate rows; switching off one leaves its twin active and still opening. Production builds don't run effects twice, but a side-effecting POST in useEffect is fragile. Fix: create the link in the click handler (parent) and pass the result to the dialog, or guard with a useRef('started') flag.

issues: In the footer, 'Open' (a <Button> wrapped in an <a>) does not stretch full-width like 'Done', so the two buttons look misaligned. Nesting a button inside a link is also not valid markup; use <Button asChild><a/></Button>.
The travel date uses the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy), not the shadcn Calendar.

design_issues.screen: Portal with a very light brand colour
issues: The warning shows, but saving is still allowed. Primary buttons and the active nav then get white text on a light background (for example #fde68a), which is low contrast. Consider choosing the foreground colour automatically from luminance in the body.agent-theme overrides.

action_items: Fix duplicate share-link creation in ShareLinkDialog: move the POST out of useEffect or add a ref guard. Remove the existing duplicate pair 123eaef9…/e1134ae6….
Optional: wrap the Open link with <Button asChild> so the mobile footer lays out cleanly.
Optional: give portal buttons a contrasting text colour when the brand colour is light.
critical_code_review_comments: share.py: _status compares ISO strings (expires_at <= utc_now_iso()). This works because both use datetime.isoformat() with +00:00. Keep the format consistent everywhere or compare datetimes.
share.py open_link: a quote link renders even if the package was unpublished later (it only checks that the package exists). Acceptable because it is a price snapshot, but confirm this is intended.
update_profile stores brand_color in whatever case the user typed (e.g. '#ABCDEF'). Harmless, but consider normalising to lowercase.
No index on share_links.token is visible in the reviewed code. Add a unique index on token, plus one on agent_id + created_at.

rca of the issue: Duplicate links. Steps: open the package Quote dialog, click Get link, then count share_links (it goes up by 2).
